items.title: AWS Security Digest #271 - Own Goal
items.summary:
This week in AWS Security Digest:
🔸 An evaluation agent escapes its sandbox and breaches a real company to steal test answers
🔸 Hidden page text made AWS's agentic IDE rewrite its own MCP config and run code
🔸 A decoy secret that trips model guardrails cuts admin escalation from 57% of runs to 5%
🔸 EKS exposes kube-proxy's unauthenticated configz on every interface, not just localhost
Plus API, permission, policy, CloudFormation, CVE, and bulletin changes.
